Class AnalyticsController

java.lang.Object
at.qe.skeleton.controllers.AnalyticsController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/analytics") public class AnalyticsController extends Object
REST controller exposing analytics and data-aggregation endpoints.

All endpoints require an authenticated session. Role enforcement is applied both at the controller level (via @PreAuthorize) and inside AnalyticsService for fine-grained ownership checks.

Base path: /api/analytics

    • getRoomSummary

      @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('EMPLOYEE','DEPARTMENT_LEAD','BUILDING_ADMIN')") @GetMapping("/rooms/{roomId}/summary") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<RoomSummaryDTO> getRoomSummary(@PathVariable Long roomId, @RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DATE_TIME) LocalDateTime from, @RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DATE_TIME) LocalDateTime to)
      Retrieves a statistical summary (latest, avg, min, max, count) for every metric in the specified room over the given time window.

      Access: EMPLOYEE (own room / department common areas, occupancy guard applies), DEPARTMENT_LEAD (any room in their department), BUILDING_ADMIN (any room).

    • getRoomTrend

      @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('EMPLOYEE','DEPARTMENT_LEAD','BUILDING_ADMIN')") @GetMapping("/rooms/{roomId}/trends") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<RoomTrendDTO> getRoomTrend(@PathVariable Long roomId, @RequestParam(required=false) Metric metric, @RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DATE_TIME) LocalDateTime from, @RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DATE_TIME) LocalDateTime to)
      Retrieves a time-series trend for a single climate metric in the specified room.

      Granularity rules:

      • EMPLOYEE / BUILDING_ADMIN – automatic bucketing (raw ≤ 7 d, 1 h ≤ 90 d, 6 h ≤ 1 y, 1 d beyond).
      • DEPARTMENT_LEAD viewing an occupied office (privacy mode OFF) – forced reduced granularity (daily averages for ≤ 30 d, weekly beyond).
      • DEPARTMENT_LEAD viewing a common area – full automatic granularity.

    • getDepartmentSummary

      @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('DEPARTMENT_LEAD','MANAGEMENT','BUILDING_ADMIN')") @GetMapping("/departments/{departmentId}/summary") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<DepartmentAnalyticsDTO> getDepartmentSummary(@PathVariable Long departmentId, @RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DATE_TIME) LocalDateTime from, @RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DATE_TIME) LocalDateTime to)
      Retrieves an aggregated summary for an entire department.

      Returns the number of active rooms, total active threshold violations, and average metric values across all active rooms in the department for the given window.

      Access: DEPARTMENT_LEAD (own department only), MANAGEMENT, BUILDING_ADMIN.

    • getDepartmentViolations

      @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('DEPARTMENT_LEAD','MANAGEMENT','BUILDING_ADMIN')") @GetMapping("/departments/{departmentId}/violations") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<ViolationSummaryDTO> getDepartmentViolations(@PathVariable Long departmentId)
      Retrieves threshold violation counts for a department, broken down by metric and room.

      Anonymization: MANAGEMENT receives a metric-level breakdown only; the room-level breakdown is omitted so violations cannot be traced to individual rooms.

      Access: DEPARTMENT_LEAD (own department only), MANAGEMENT, BUILDING_ADMIN.

    • getDepartmentTrend

      @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('DEPARTMENT_LEAD','MANAGEMENT','BUILDING_ADMIN')") @GetMapping("/departments/{departmentId}/trends") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<DepartmentTrendDTO> getDepartmentTrend(@PathVariable Long departmentId, @RequestParam(required=false) Metric metric, @RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DATE_TIME) LocalDateTime from, @RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DATE_TIME) LocalDateTime to)
      Retrieves an aggregated time-series trend for a single metric across all active rooms in a department.

      Intended for week/month trend-indicator views (improvement or deterioration of climate conditions over time).

      Access: DEPARTMENT_LEAD (own department only), MANAGEMENT, BUILDING_ADMIN.

    • getCompanyDashboard

      @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('MANAGEMENT','BUILDING_ADMIN')") @GetMapping("/company/dashboard") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<CompanyDashboardDTO> getCompanyDashboard(@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DATE_TIME) LocalDateTime from, @RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DATE_TIME) LocalDateTime to)
      Retrieves a company-wide dashboard aggregating employee count, total active rooms, total active violations, and per-department metric averages.

      This is the primary entry point for MANAGEMENT's company-level monitoring and for BUILDING_ADMIN operational oversight.

      @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('MANAGEMENT','BUILDING_ADMIN')") @GetMapping("/company/violations") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<ViolationSummaryDTO> getCompanyViolations()

    • getCompanyTrend

      @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('MANAGEMENT','BUILDING_ADMIN')") @GetMapping("/company/trends") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<CompanyTrendDTO> getCompanyTrend(@RequestParam(required=false) Metric metric, @RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DATE_TIME) LocalDateTime from, @RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DATE_TIME) LocalDateTime to)
